description: Master crypto slang, abbreviations, and street terms every crypto student needs to know — through crosswords, word hunts, and more.

lessons.title: Crossword: Crypto Street Slang
lessons.description: Solve the crossword using the clues below. Every answer is a real term used in crypto communities.

placed.clue: The anxiety of missing out on a big price move (abbr.)
When a coin's price shoots dramatically upward
To aggressively hype a coin, often because you own it
An investor who holds a massive amount of cryptocurrency
A legendary typo that became a strategy: never sell
When you've lost most of your investment (from 'wrecked')
A rapid, often artificial price spike
A rapid price crash, usually after a pump

lessons.title: Word Hunt: Market Mood Words
lessons.description: Find all 8 crypto terms hidden in the grid. Each word has its definition shown — find the word that matches!

words.definition: Fear, Uncertainty, Doubt — negative info spread to crash prices
Expecting prices to rise; optimistic about the market
Expecting prices to fall; pessimistic about the market
All-Time High — the highest price a coin has ever reached
All-Time Low — the lowest price a coin has ever hit
Symbol of crypto success ('when Lambo?' = 'when are we rich?')
Not Gonna Make It — said about bad decisions or lost causes
We're All Gonna Make It — community optimism and solidarity

lessons.title: Match It: Crypto Essentials
lessons.description: Connect each term on the left to its correct definition on the right. All 8 terms are fundamental to understanding crypto.

pairs.definition: Do Your Own Research — always verify before investing
The smallest unit of Bitcoin (0.00000001 BTC)
A distributed ledger that records transactions in linked blocks
Locking up crypto to help secure a network and earn rewards
Free tokens sent to wallet holders, usually as a promotion
The cost to process a transaction on the Ethereum network
Software or hardware that stores your private keys

lessons.title: Flashcards: DeFi & NFT Terms
lessons.description: Flip each card to reveal the definition. Mark what you know and what to review — go through the full deck to complete the lesson.

cards.definition: Non-Fungible Token — a unique digital asset on the blockchain. Unlike Bitcoin, no two NFTs are identical.
To create a new NFT or token on the blockchain for the first time — like printing a digital collectible.
Permanently removing tokens from circulation by sending them to an unspendable address — reduces supply.
Decentralized Finance — financial services (lending, trading, earning) built on blockchains with no banks.
Decentralized Exchange — trade crypto directly from your wallet with no company holding your funds.
A scam where developers launch a project, raise money, then disappear with all investor funds.
Centralized Exchange — a company-run crypto platform (like Coinbase) that holds your keys for you.
When a leveraged position is automatically closed because your losses hit the maximum allowed limit.

lessons.title: Emoji Decode: Advanced Crypto Terms
lessons.description: Each emoji combo represents a crypto term. Decode all 8 to complete the lesson!

items.hint: Holding through the worst dips without selling
items.definition: Holding your crypto no matter how much the price drops — refusing to sell during panic.

items.hint: Selling too early when things get scary
items.definition: Selling your crypto at the first sign of a price drop — the opposite of diamond hands.

items.hint: Price × total supply of a coin
items.definition: The total value of a cryptocurrency — calculated as current price multiplied by circulating supply.

items.hint: How wildly a price swings up and down
items.definition: How dramatically and unpredictably a cryptocurrency's price changes over time.

items.hint: Bitcoin uses this — miners solve puzzles
items.definition: A consensus mechanism where miners compete using computing power to validate transactions.

items.hint: Ethereum uses this — validators lock up coins
items.definition: A consensus mechanism where validators stake their own crypto as collateral to validate transactions.

items.hint: Prolonged price decline of 20%+ — opposite of bull run
items.definition: A sustained period of falling crypto prices, typically a decline of 20% or more from recent highs.

items.hint: How all the nodes in a network agree on what happened
items.definition: The process by which all nodes in a blockchain network agree on the valid state of the ledger.
